correctness.rationale: In even characteristic the nondegenerate symplectic polar form and unique square roots yield M=q−1 split or q+1 nonsplit nonzero-level points, including q=2. For s≠0, Q(v)=Q(v+s)=j reduces to B(v,s)=Q(s); isotropic s cannot be a sum and nonisotropic s yields an affine F_q-line parameter t with equation t²+t=constant, hence 0 or 2 ordered pairs. All diagonal pairs sum to zero and offdiagonal unordered pairs have distinct sums. Character orthogonality gives ‖Ef‖₄⁴=(q²/M⁴)(|Σf²|²+2T²−2Σ|f|⁴) under the stated surface-probability/output-counting normalization. Cauchy and triangle give sharp (q²/M²)(3−2/M) with exactly common modulus and common squared phase, hence c independent signs and 2^(M−1) projective classes. Algebra yields nonnegative deficit 2Σ(a−1/M)²+1−|Σz|²; remains valid M=1.
